name: smwmusic-pok-mon-gold-silver-crystal-battle-gym-leader-kanto
title: Pokémon Gold/Silver/Crystal - Battle! Gym Leader (Kanto)
description:
This is a port of the battle theme from the generation II Pokémon games that plays when challenging the Kanto gym leaders. This only uses 3 channels and 2 samples to give off the simplistic vibes that the original song had. Best used for bosses or other battle scenes.

MIDI credit: Joo *Johnnyz* Buaes
